newsitem.title: USA: HCC Insurance to buy North American Special.
newsitem.headline: HCC Insurance to buy North American Special.

text.p: HCC Insurance Holdings Inc said Friday it agreed to buy all outstanding shares of the North American Special Risks Associates Inc group of companies in exchange for 1,176,000 shares of HCC's common stock.
The company said the acquisition awaits finalization of definitive agreements and could close by September's end.
North American Special Risk Associates specializes in occupational accident coverage for the transportation industry.
HCC Insurance said it believes the transaction would have a positive effect on its 1996 and 1997 earnings per share.
